workload.description: S5(x1..x4, z) = 0 mod p with |x_i| < p^delta, support = full box [0,8]^4 (6561 monomials, measured on a random 61-bit prime field, random a, b, z; no registered curve id, the computation is curve-independent); asymptotic p -> infinity reach of full-rank triangular single-polynomial Coppersmith lattices

metric: asymptotic small-root exponent delta* (exact closure optimum at finite multiplicity; box-family limit)
note: delta*(S5) = 1/80 for JM basic/extended and for the exact optimum over all monomial sets (70/70 closure cells equal the best box; S5 exact to l=3: 0.006334, bounded box); the whole family is capped at 1/32 for every l by a charging argument. Needed delta ~ 1/5 for arity m = 4, so this route is closed for that family; sublattice/linearisation, multi-polynomial and cuso Groebner-cancelling shifts are not covered.
